map.→ 打开字符频率分析工具: -> Open the character frequency analysis tool
map.可选。做信息论熵估计时通常计入空格；做纯用词分析时建议排除标点与空白，只留有效字: Optional. For information-theoretic entropy estimates spaces are usually counted; for pure word usage analysis exclude punctuation and whitespace and keep only valid characters.
map.密码学/信息论教学：统计一段明文的字母频率，直观看到英文 e/t/a 高频、中文: Cryptography and information theory teaching: count letter frequencies in a plaintext to see the English e/t/a pattern and how Chinese distributes by character frequency.
map.文本熵粗估：用字符分布估算压缩潜力或随机性，辅助判断是否为加密/乱码。: Rough text entropy estimate: use character distribution to estimate compression potential or randomness, helping judge whether it is encrypted or garbled.
map.空格和标点算字符吗？: Do spaces and punctuation count as characters?
map.统计文本中每个字符出现的次数与占比并可视化排序，适用于词频分析、密码强度检查与日: Counts how often each character appears with its share and visualises the ranking, for word frequency analysis, password strength checks and log feature extraction; it runs purely in the front end and never leaks the input.
map.词频与用词习惯分析：统计稿件中高频字，发现重复用词以便润色。: Word frequency and usage habit analysis: counts high-frequency characters in a draft to spot repeated wording for polishing.
map.默认区分，因密码分析常需保留大小写差异；如需语言字频对比，先统一大小写再统计，否: Case is distinguished by default because password analysis often needs case differences; for language frequency comparison, unify the case first, otherwise A and a count as two characters.
map.：字符 a 出现 5 次、b 2 次、r 2 次、c 1 次、d 1 次，共 1: : the character a appears 5 times, b 2 times, r 2 times, c 1 time, d 1 time, 11 characters total; a is at 45.5% frequency. This matches the "frequent letters give it away" teaching point in Caesar/Vigenere cipher frequency analysis.
